name: J-DH3
description: J-DH3 was a Haxion Brood Bounty Droid who served the Haxion Brood crime syndicate during the Imperial Era. Once a loadlifter droid, the Haxion Brood reprogrammed the droid and enhanced J-DH3 with salvaged parts. They had yellow-and-blue plating, white sensors, and a built-in wrist blaster.
